description: Independent held-out synthetic known-solution fixtures. No solver was run or consulted during generation. Each color/orientation case has a distinct seed, background and four-way reverse scramble; variants are not transformed copies. Only geometrically possible separated target placements are constructed, and only goal-preserving extra target orbs are added before scrambling. Final inputs are never filtered for initial goal status, difficulty or solver success. A witness proves a legal path exists, not that a bounded solver can find it. Ordinary boards only: no spinners, hazards, tape, activities, bonus columns, custom erase thresholds or device operations.

generation.seedSchedule: 202611060000 + scenarioIndex*100 + color*4 + variant; scenario order is recorded by the cases
generation.rng: Python random.Random with integer seed; the saved boards and witnesses are authoritative
generation.quarterTurns: L/T/Four use variant 0..3; mixed second shape uses variant+1 mod4. Cross/Square rotations are identical. Row/Column retain their specified axis and randomize placement.

validation.independentOracle: passed: sliding triples, union-find components, geometric shape predicates and independent gravity
validation.publicPythonOracleCrossCheck: passed for every witness and starting board; goals, combos, erased and first-wave combos agree
validation.witnessReplay: passed: board restored exactly, four-way moves, 32/40/48 steps, all requested first-wave goal counts
